summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K for May 2026 to submit annual financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certifications (Forms 52-109F1), and auditor consents for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The certifications affirm no material misstatements and the design of disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting. This is a routine periodic report of a Canadian foreign private issuer, equivalent to an annual report filing under U.S. securities law. There are no special-situation elements such as mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, or strategic changes. The filing is purely administrative and regulatory in nature.
